components.name: List Row
components.summary: A table row: a title, with an optional symbol, subtitle and detail, and a chevron, checkmark or switch at the end. It highlights while pressed and reports taps.

components.name: Status Bar
components.summary: The time, signal, Wi-Fi and battery along the top of the screen.

components.name: Large Title Bar
components.summary: A navigation bar with a large title. Cable a scroll view's Offset into Scroll Offset (it goes below zero as the content moves up): the bar shrinks as the content scrolls and the title moves into the bar.

components.name: Tab Bar
components.summary: Tabs with a symbol and a title each; tapping one selects it. Give it comma-separated titles and symbol names. It is a capsule of glass as wide as its tabs, floating above the bottom of the screen, as on iOS 26; with Floating off it is a flat bar from edge to edge.

components.name: Home Indicator
components.summary: The bar at the bottom of the screen that a swipe up starts from. It lies over whatever is there, a tab bar included.

value.value: A message that says what happened.

text.value: A message that says what happened.

components.summary: An alert over the whole screen: a title, a message and buttons from a comma-separated list. A tap on a button dismisses it and says which. Pulse Present to show it again.
